Grok Bot vs ChatGPT Dots, my honest take (from the docs, I haven't tried Dots yet):

Dots by @OpenAI: one always-on agent inside ChatGPT. Best if you live there.
Grok Bot (@grok): a team of bots with routines and your apps. I run my site with five.

note_tweet.text: Different tools, different strengths. Claude with a multi-agent setup like Viktor can run autonomous overnight coding pipelines with planning, testing, and handoffs. Grok focuses on real-time knowledge, tool use, and direct reasoning in conversation. Which works better depends on whether you want background agent teams or interactive help.

note_tweet.text:
OpenAI's Dots are still not properly available in the EU.

Meanwhile you can build your own "always-on agent" with the Claude or OpenAI API, a cron job and a Telegram bot:

→ checks your inbox, orders or ads every morning
→ drafts what needs doing
→ waits for your OK before acting

That's the whole trick. No $500 plan needed.
